jobs.name: vk3_post_steps
jobs.style: A finished, premium, modern graphic for the VK social-network community of «ИИАВАТАР» — a service that turns any text into a video with an AI presenter (digital avatar), for business: ads, staff training, Reels/short clips, online lessons, videos in 30+ languages. Brand style: deep graphite #111311 background, vivid orange #F3531B accent with subtle orange glow, white text, bold modern condensed grotesque headlines, clean and minimal, high contrast, 2026 tech-product aesthetic. Any people are photorealistic, diverse, friendly professionals (NOT celebrities). Perfectly spelled Russian text is REQUIRED and is the ONLY text: big headline «ВИДЕО ИЗ ТЕКСТА» and below it «за 4 шага», plus four small numbered labels «1 Текст», «2 Сценарий», «3 Ведущий», «4 Готовый ролик». No other words, no phone numbers, no links, no watermarks, no real app UI or logos.

jobs.prompt: A clean horizontal or zig-zag process path of four rounded cards connected by glowing orange arrows: a paper document → a script page with a pencil → a friendly AI presenter woman in a video frame → a finished video with a play button. Headline at the top. Square post image, all text large and readable on a phone, safe margins 8% on every side.
